description: This source file defines a React component named ExecutionHistoryList, which displays a list of execution records in either a table or card format, with features for copying execution IDs, navigating to detailed views, and showing status indicators. It retrieves dependencies from component libraries and utility modules related to UI, status handling, and routing.

methods.name: ExecutionHistoryList
methods.description: React functional component that renders a list of executions, supporting actions like copy, navigate, and responsive layout.

methods.name: handleCopyExecution
methods.description: Copies the given execution ID to clipboard.

methods.name: handleNavigateToExecution
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed page for a specific execution ID.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Handles click events on a table row to navigate to execution details unless an action button was clicked.

methods.name: handleCopyClick
methods.description: Stops propagation and triggers copying of execution ID.

methods.name: handleViewDetailsClick
methods.description: Stops propagation and triggers navigation to execution detail page.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp string into relative time or date string.

methods.name: getStatusMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata (icon, label, variant) for a given execution status.
